phases.name: Presentation
phases.content: In this unit you will learn how to report what other people said, using reported speech.

phases.name: Discovery
phases.content: Read these sentences. I am tired. She said she was tired. Where do you live? He asked where I lived. Close the door. She told me to close the door. Notice how tenses shift back.

phases.name: Guided practice
phases.explanation: Present Simple becomes Past Simple in reported speech.

phases.name: Free practice
phases.prompt: Imagine a conversation with a friend. Report 3 things they said.

phases.name: Mini-test
phases.prompt: She asked me ___ I liked pizza.
phases.explanation: Yes/no questions are reported with if or whether.
